article.story: EVANSVILLE, Ind. -- — Kachi Nzeh had 21 points in Little Rock's 77-62 victory over Southern Indiana on Thursday night. Nzeh went 9 of 10 from the field (3 for 4 from 3-point range) for the Trojans (3-9, 1-1 Ohio Valley Conference). Cameron Wallace added 19 points and 13 rebounds. Johnathan Lawson had 18 points for the Trojans, who ended a seven-game skid with the win. Ismail Habib led the way for the Screaming Eagles (3-8, 0-1) with 21 points. Cardell Bailey added 18 points and four steals for Southern Indiana. Kaden Brown finished with seven points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
